title: Finish-Item Cash Settlement: Calloway Limited Home Warranty Terms of Offer and Acceptance
content:
## Terms of offer

A finish-item cash settlement under the Calloway Limited Home Warranty is cash paid to the homeowner in place of Calloway repairing a covered finish (workmanship) claim item. A finish-item cash settlement is offered on the claim item of the most recent workmanship approval recorded on the coverage, whether that approval is the item's original approval or an accepted callback, and it becomes a payout only when the homeowner accepts it in writing.

The finish settlement is fixed only after every missed appointment on the coverage that the missed-appointment rules make chargeable carries its missed-appointment charge.

On acceptance the settlement is recorded as an approved payout of the kind cash in lieu for that claim item, with its own payout number, and its amount is added to the payouts Calloway owes the homeowner on the coverage; the item is thereby closed without repair.

## Recording the homeowner's acceptance

Tool: `accept_finish_item_cash_settlement_135d939d`. This is the homeowner's own tool: the desk agent unlocks it and hands it over, and the customer themselves (the homeowner) runs it to record their own written acceptance. One run records one approved payout, dated the day of the run.

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `coverage_id` | The reference number of the homeowner's own warranty coverage on the home, as given to the homeowner by the warranty desk from the coverage lookup | Identifier, as given by the desk |
| `claim_item_ref` | The service request item number of the finish item being settled | Copied character for character, digits and hyphens included, exactly as printed on the homeowner's service request, with no reformatting |
| `amount` | The cash settlement amount the homeowner accepts, in US dollars | A positive number with 2 decimal places, already rounded to the nearest cent; no currency sign or thousands separator |

## What the run returns

A receipt whose `status` is `settlement_accepted` means the acceptance is on file. The receipt also gives `warranty_event_id` (reference number of the new payout entry), `payout_reference` (the payout number, text such as WPO-51234), `coverage_id` (the coverage the payout belongs to), `claim_item_ref` (the item settled and closed), `payout_type` (always `cash_in_lieu`), `amount` (US dollars, 2 decimal places), `event_date` (the acceptance date, YYYY-MM-DD) and `payouts_owed` (approved payouts not yet paid on the coverage including this acceptance, US dollars, 2 decimal places).

**Basis Q&A.**
- *Is an offer a payout before the homeowner accepts?* No; it becomes a payout only on the homeowner's written acceptance.
- *What becomes of the item once the acceptance is recorded?* It is closed without repair.
